scope: Original R-CILQR B201 reference only; baseline for the independent nominal LTV-MPC tracking follow-up.
dense_sampling_method: Linear interpolation of x/y/gamma and unwrapped heading between the fixed archived states; no reference resimulation or smoothing.
obstacle_clock: Obstacle positions advance from their archived initial states at absolute execution time t, independently of any retimed reference progress.

joint_extended_rectangles.geometry: rectangles extended to the articulation joint

interpretation: Collision and clearance results apply only to this map and this original time profile; they must be recomputed against absolute obstacle time for a retimed execution.
Rate and acceleration feasibility are assessed separately above; geometric clearance alone does not establish feasibility for the 6-state lagged plant.
A new speed/progress profile must be archived separately and must not overwrite or re-anchor this reference to the actual state at each cycle.
The 0.1 m RMSE, 0.3 m maximum error and 0.05 m actual clearance criteria are engineering acceptance targets for this follow-up, not a paper or industry standard.
No continuous-time or real-vehicle safety claim follows from sampled polygon checks.
